query: SELECT name AS "name!", started_at AS "started_at!" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (br.archive_name) br.archive_name AS name, br.started_at FROM backup_reports br WHERE br.repo_id = $1 AND br.agent_id = $2 AND br.archive_name IS NOT NULL AND br.status IN ('success', 'warning') ORDER BY br.archive_name, br.started_at DESC, br.id DESC) latest ORDER BY started_at DESC, name DESC
